Method & automatic retirement方法与自动收起规则
Disclosure importance ranks action type, book weight, share-count change, position rank, and the manager's descriptive historical grade. It is not an expected-return or buy score. This radar retires automatically at 26/50 filings, when the expected quarter becomes a strict majority and the main boards switch to the paired-reporter cohort. The original SEC-reported value is retained. Post-2023 filings that still match the legacy thousands-unit shape are normalized and flagged. A 13F-NT satisfies a filing obligation but contains no holdings book. It is shown separately and never counted as a zero-position portfolio.

Descriptive flow, not a signal. Open-market trades only (P/S transaction codes) — grants and awards are excluded. The Form-4 lane is daily; the SEC role panel lags ~45 days.
